headlines.snippet: Sgt. Maj. Ron Yonatan Reitman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Suham fell in a terror attack at the Yehuda Junction. Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Suham, 20, from Hod Hasharon, served in the Extraction Brigade. Three other soldiers were wounded. The military estimates the attackers planned a larger attack on civilians. The two attackers were neutralized, and a foreign photographer is being investigated for prior knowledge. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown on Hebron and a full closure of the West Bank.
